programme.desc: New York Knicks at Detroit Pistons in Game 6 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Little Caesars Arena. The visitors have won four of five games in this series as New York takes a 3-2 edge back to Motown, where the Pistons have lost an NBA record-tying nine straight playoff games. Third-year center Jalen Duren had nine points, 14 boards and six assists in Detroit's 106-103 Game 5 win.

programme.title: NBA Playoff

programme.desc: Boston Celtics at New York Knicks in Game 4 of an Eastern Conference semifinal series. From Madison Square Garden. New York's series lead is down to 2-1 after a 115-93 loss in Game 3 that drops the Knicks to 1-3 at home this postseason. Boston led wire-to-wire and shot a sizzling 50 percent from beyond the arc, with all five starters sinking a three, plus five from Payton Pritchard (23 points).

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics in Game 5 of an Eastern Conference semifinal series. From TD Garden. The Knicks are one win away from their first conference final in a quarter century after fending off Boston 121-113 in Game 4 behind Jalen Brunson's 39 points and 12 assists. Celtics star Jayson Tatum left with a leg injury in the final minutes after pouring in 42 points.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 6: Boston Celtics at New York Knicks
programme.desc: Boston Celtics at New York Knicks in Game 6 of an Eastern Conference semifinal series. From Madison Square Garden. Down 3-2, reigning-champion Boston won't go quietly despite losing star forward Jayson Tatum to injury. Jaylen Brown, Derrick White (60 points combined) and reserve center Luke Kornet starred in a 127-102 Game 5 win, delaying New York's bid for its first Eastern final in 25 years.

programme.title: NBA Playoff

programme.desc: Minnesota Timberwolves at Los Angeles Lakers in Game 1 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Crypto.com Arena. Now wearing Lakers gold, Luke Doncic tries to oust Anthony Edwards and Minnesota for a second straight postseason after willing Dallas to a 4-1 win in the 2024 West finals. Twenty years earlier was the T-Wolves' last playoff meeting with the Lakers, a 4-2 West finals loss.

programme.title: NBA Playoff

programme.desc: Minnesota Timberwolves at Los Angeles Lakers in Game 2 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Crypto.com Arena. Anthony Edwards and the T-Wolves try to replicate their fine form from a 117-95 win in Game 1, the Lakers' first at home since 2012. Minnesota shot 21-for-42 from long range, including six threes from Naz Reid. Newest Laker Luka Doncic tallied 37 in defeat.

programme.title: NBA Playoff

programme.desc: Los Angeles Lakers at Minnesota Timberwolves in Game 3 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Target Center. This is the same court where Doncic (with Dallas) ended Minnesota's season last May with three road wins in the Western Conference finals.

programme.title: NBA Playoff

programme.desc: Los Angeles Lakers at Minnesota Timberwolves in Game 4 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Target Center. programme.title: Ligue 1. "Marseille" - PSG
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: CSI S5 E19 - 4x4
programme.desc: Some provocative episodes from Season 5 of CSI involve Russian mail order brides (\"Nesting Dolls\"), infantism (\"King Baby\"), and the Mexican lifestyle of narcocorrido (\"Snakes\"). From the creative storytelling (\"4x4\") to the macabre (\"Who Shot Sherlock?\"), there’s something in Season 5 for everyone. The CSI team investigates many crimes that hit close to home as well. Grissom comes under fire from Ecklie (\"Mea Culpa\"), Brass tracks down his estranged daughter (\"Hollywood Brass\"), and during the course of the season Greg Sanders completes his transition from the lab to the field. Last, but not least, Season 5 wraps with an amazing two-part episode (\"Grave Danger\"), written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, where Nick comes face to face with death while the team exhausts all its resources to same him.

programme.title: CSI S5 E23 - Iced
programme.desc: Some provocative episodes from Season 5 of CSI involve Russian mail order brides (\"Nesting Dolls\"), infantism (\"King Baby\"), and the Mexican lifestyle of narcocorrido (\"Snakes\"). From the creative storytelling (\"4x4\") to the macabre (\"Who Shot Sherlock?\"), there’s something in Season 5 for everyone. The CSI team investigates many crimes that hit close to home as well. Grissom comes under fire from Ecklie (\"Mea Culpa\"), Brass tracks down his estranged daughter (\"Hollywood Brass\"), and during the course of the season Greg Sanders completes his transition from the lab to the field. Last, but not least, Season 5 wraps with an amazing two-part episode (\"Grave Danger\"), written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, where Nick comes face to face with death while the team exhausts all its resources to same him.

Legally Blonde
programme.desc: Elle Woods, a fashionable sorority girl, enrols in Harvard Law School to win back her ex-boyfriend. Despite initial struggles, she discovers her true potential and excels in her studies.

programme.title: Legally Blonde 2: Red, White & Blonde
programme.desc: A recent Harvard Law graduate, Elle Woods campaigns for Bruiser's Bill in Washington DC. She overcomes many obstacles to win her fight against animal testing.

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon
programme.desc: Isabelle plans to marry a stranger to break a family curse, which leads every first marriage to end in a divorce, in order to get married to her long-time boyfriend Pierre.

programme.title: Fallen
programme.desc: Detective John Hobbes witnesses the execution of a demonic serial killer, Edgar Reese. However, questions arise when the murders start again, eerily matching the modus operandi of Reese.

programme.title: Love Is in the Air
programme.desc: Antonie and Julie, past lovers, coincidently find themselves seated next to each other on a flight. As conversation ensues, past memories are revived, as they strive to understand each other again.

programme.title: The Nut Job
programme.desc: An exiled squirrel plans to rob a nut store to provide food for his former colony. Unfortunately, the store is also a front for bank robbers.

programme.title: Live - Mandira Bedi; The Love Laugh Live Show
programme.desc: The host invites prominent personalities and engages them in candid conversations about their personal and professional lives.

programme.title: Live - Mandira Bedi; The Love Laugh Live Show
programme.desc: The host invites prominent personalities and engages them in candid conversations about their personal and professional lives.

programme.title: Carpool
programme.desc: Daniel Miller has to take care of the carpool for his sons and the neighbourhood school children when his wife falls sick. However, in the course of the day, he finds himself a victim of a robbery.

programme.title: Big Momma's House 2
programme.desc: Malcolm Turner, an FBI agent, reprises his disguise as a Southern grandmother and works as a nanny to unveil the culprits responsible for designing a deadly computer virus.

programme.title: Deck the Halls
programme.desc: When his new neighbour's extravagant Christmas decorations appear, a man feels challenged and initiates a spirited decorating competition.

programme.title: Penelope
programme.desc: A young girl hailing from an affluent family embarks on a quest for true love to dispel a curse that has pervaded her family.

programme.title: Overboard
programme.desc: A wrongfully terminated employee convinces her spoiled and wealthy ex-boss that they are married after he falls off his yacht and gets amnesia.

programme.title: What Happens in Vegas
programme.desc: After a night of wild partying, two strangers awake and find they have married each other.

programme.title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
programme.desc: After FBI agent Malcolm Turner's stepson, Trent, witnesses a murder, the two are forced to go undercover. While Malcolm turns into Big Momma, Trent disguises himself as Charmaine.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Henry falls in love with Lucy, whose short-term memory loss makes her forget him every time she falls asleep. As a result, Henry decides to win her over every day after she wakes up.

programme.title: What's Your Number?
programme.desc: With her career crashing and her boyfriend dumping her, Ally tries to contact her former partners in the desperate hope of finding true love.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: When Django, a slave, is freed, he joins forces with a bounty hunter to rescue his wife, who has been enslaved by Calvin, a hard-hearted plantation owner.

programme.title: The Revenant
programme.desc: Frontiersman Hugh Glass is severely injured in a bear attack and abandoned by his hunting crew. Refusing to give up, he uses his skills to survive and take revenge on the companion who betrayed him.

programme.title: The Family Fang
programme.desc: After the police inform them about their parents' mysterious disappearance, two siblings embark on a mission to uncover the truth.

programme.title: The Idle Class
programme.desc: A tramp bumps into a woman in an upscale resort where she is arguing with her drunk husband. Complications arise when she mistakes the tramp to be her husband.

programme.title: Woman in Gold
programme.desc: Maria Altman, a Jewish refugee, along with her lawyer Randy Schoenberg, faces several difficulties while reclaiming the painting of her aunt, which was seized by the Nazis before World War II.

programme.title: Texas Killing Fields
